text: Pros: It's flexible and soft texture makes it a pleasure to wear. It's also very easy to install and replace the band. Cons: It could be just me, but it irritated my skin on the wrist below my palm. The band feels great. when worn, it keeps the watch looking great. I bought this band to keep my included leather strap from all the sweat I would create while going on my runs. It did the trick, but an irritation and redness formed while wearing the band, so I had to keep from wearing it over night for sleep tracking. I'll be looking for another active band to see if I can wear overnight, hence the mark down in stars. If you are looking for a band that you just want to use in the gym/running, grab this band. That's what I use it for, but I expected to be able to wear it more than that.
title: Great workout band. Irritation kept me from using this band overnight.

text: As of now the tiny bottle of fluid that comes with the package was not even enough for even one protector let alone the other that comes in the package. Spray bottle is empty and the screen protector is coming up on rounded edges of of my s10 plus I have an email into customer service. If what I hear is true this will probably be changed to a different rating later. Fingers crossed Update- the solution problem was addressed by customer service rather quickly. With the curved edges of my s10+ the protector never cleanly applied which bothered me and I went with liquid glass instead.
title: Hard for keep on rounded samsung galaxy edges

text: This is actually case compatible! Looks good and provides the protection I expect from tempered glass. I'm not a huge fan of the black edges, mostly because they feel unnecessary to me, but they're not a distreaction either. There is a small decrease in sensitivity, but it's really not that bad. It doesn't decrease functionality, and I'm fairly certain I'll adjust to the difference after a day or two of use. I'm writing this immediately after application. UPDATE I did indeed get used to the difference in screen sensitivity, but unfortunately I don't like it much. It's more significant than it was after application, so now I often have problems with typing accurately. This screen is also terrible with fingerprints, and the adhesive around the edges collects dust and lint. My husband hates his (but luckily still uses it). On the bright side, the protection is still great. I have several deep scratches in the glass that I'm lucky to have avoided being put o n the screen instead. So on that note I'm glad I didn't just give up on the thing.
title: Glad to have it, sensitivity not too different

text: Excellent case fits my iPhone 6 perfectly - looks really sleek and seems barely visible - you can really show off the actual phone itself plus it perfectly covers and fits all the different tools so they work nicely. I also loved the fact that this case arrived very promptly, together with my scratch resistant cover and care kit. Thanks so much to the owner for emailing me separately to find out whether I was happy with my purchase. This was a nice touch & very much appreciated! I'm more than happy & would definitely recommend the which is my 2nd i-Blason case in 2 years now so they are very durable for the price & look wonderful. Go for it it's well worth it with this company!
title: Brilliant value case!

text: I bought the stylus pen because I recently started to use Procreate. I was excited when I received the pen and had great results using it to draw and create until it was time to recharge the pen. I couldn’t get the charging light to stay on because the connection between the pen and wire was too loose. I then contacted Amazon and was offered a refund or a replacement. Since I didn’t have any issues with the pens performance, I opted for a replacement. Maybe this one got through the quality control inspection. Any way, I opted to give the company another chance. As it turned out I received the replacement before I made the return so I decided to see if the problem was with the pen or the wire. It was with the wire. So I made the return and checked the new pen and wire which fit great. Unfortunately the pen did not. It started skipping, shutting off on its own and even erasing previously drawn lines. As the saying goes,”Third times’s the charm” but not in this case. I returned the 2nd pen and ordered one from a different company on Amazon. Fingers crossed, I am to get it on Tuesday!
title: Too good to be true

text: Got this as a Lightning Deal. The holder is decent for the discounted price. If I had to pay full price then I would be more disappointed. The strength of clamps around my iPhone Xs are determined by its weight on the bottom cradle. I have a Spigen Tough Armor case with a metal back which gives added weight. But the clamps don’t hold my phone as snug as I would think it would. As a result, the phone moves around. It doesn’t come out of the clamps but it’s not secured in place. Good things I’ve found with this: the clip which affixes the holder to the vent slat is very strong. Went over a couple of speed bumps and pot holes and managed to stay in place; the phone kept in the clamps but moved around a little bit. Also, while the cable appears to be short, it’s long enough for those vehicles with the charging port in the arm rest/center storage in between the front seats. I give it 3.5 stars.
title: It’s just OK

text: I waited 2 days to open the box on my iPhone 13. I wanted a case and screen protector before I even turned the phone on. The package comes with no instructions. There is a video link on the box. That just takes you to pictures of LK products. I search online for instructions. I find a video with no sound. I wasted two protectors trying to get one on. There was a spot under the screen cover that was not going to smooth out. Had I never replaced a glass cover There’s no way you could figure this out. I have replaced over the years probably 20 screen covers and could not get this to work.
title: No instructions, wasted 2

text: As everyone who owns a note 9 knows, it's difficult to get something to protect the screen. I've tried glass screen protectors that just fall off because they are only sticky on the edges. I've tried cases with built in covers and they get so scratched you can't see the screen. I bought this thinking a good, sticky film would be a good option, and easy to change when it gets scratched. This is nothing more than thick cling wrap. There is no stickyness or adhesive. It does not cling to the curve of the phone screen, and the bubbles are horrible. I tried all 4 thinking I was doing something wrong or had a bad batch, but same results. This is a waste of money.
title: DO NOT BUY

text: As somoene who got the Samsung Galaxy S4 as an early release before the cases hit the stores, I had to get some type of case quickly to protect the phone. With a prime membership, I ordered this as one-day shipping and still got it under $10 and shipped so I had a case right away. I like the grip/feel of the case but I don't like how it is difficult to use the power on/off button. Keep in mind the Samsung Galaxy S4 has a light plastic body so it really needs protection and I would advise against buying this case unless you are looking for something immediately to hold off until a better selection of cases are released. I also threw away the screen protector. It was a really cheap plastic protector that looked like it would only lessen the quality of the the nice 5 inch screen.
title: Nothing to write home about.

text: This was amazing the first week. Looks better than the picture and was over my expectations. After the first week, the plastic started getting kind of bubbly which makes it nearly impossible to see when it's on your arm while running. I haven't left it in my car, but I do live in south Florida where is is very hot. Maybe that is what caused it? Either way, it shouldn't have happened after just a week. If you don't mind the screen getting bubbly/wavy then this is definitely the band for you! It works well and the cord holder is a nice added feature that I thought I didn't need.
title: Loved for the first week

text: Product is well built and a no brainer if you don't use CD player much. The 6 magnets inside hold even a larger phone in place well. Had a different brand with same concept that did not hold phone in place well when you hit bumps. This one will even hold my wife's larger phone in place on a bumpy road. It easily installs into CD player opening with the tightening of crank and stays put. It is easy to use and does not appear to damage CD player if you take it out. I bought one for second vehicle and tossed out other brand.
title: Easy to use and strong magnets will hold phone in place

text: Purchased this frame in Sept 2021. It didn't take long for it to crack on the edge with just one drop. First, this ads a bit of weight to the phone. Feels sturdy but it doesn't do well fitting into hands free holders and trying to attach a magnetic metal piece for one of the vent holders, it continues to fall off and the metal attachment won't stick to the rubber frame. The poor design also renders the "touch" login inaccessible. You can't fit your finger on the on off button for it to recognize your identity. Can't recommend for purchase. I would send it back for a replacement or refund, but the cost of postage is more than the actual cost of the frame. It also cracked the glass "unbreakable" protector. Will try another brand.
title: Well that didn't last long

text: The case is decent enough. It feels very sturdy for the most part. There is a lot of room for improvement tho. The back hinge cover is not flush to the phone when it is open. Closed it is great. The mini screen cover doesn't stay open unless the phone is open. If the flip is closed then the cover is down and blocking the screen. But if those were fixed this would probably be a great case and 5 stars across the board. Review updated: After receiving a replacement and using for a little bit I am extremely disappointed and unsatisfied. Not heavy duty at all. The camera cover doesn't stay open properly and if you drop your phone the hinge cover pops off.
title: Do not Recommend

text: I love the way this holder mounts on my vent. The pivot ability, the stability arm, and the way it locks into the vent are great. Other vent mounts haven’t been compatible with my deep SUV air vents. My phone feels very secure in the holder, too. It works with and without a phone case on both an iPhone SE & iPhone 8. My only issues are with how it opens. It’s a sloth......sooooo....slow. It also gets stuck fairly often and has to be forced open, or the button to open has to be pushed multiple times. Otherwise, I’m fairly satisfied with it.
title: Like how it mounts, but slow to open or gets stuck

text: I would definitely choose the Defender series by OtterBox instead of this Commuter series. This case is more slimly styled if that is really important to you, but also looses some better features in the streamlining. The case is made of a pliable rubber (I do not know if it has any latex component) with thicker sides than back. The hard case is in my opinion slippery to hold (a big negative!). the hard case also only reaches the side of the phone partially on each side, leaving the corners of the phone only covered in the rubber sleeve. the toggle control pads work ok despite the much less overall stability of the case. There is no clip on the caseback or holder. The tabs which cover the earphone jack and charging plug work a little difficultly. I feel that the purpose for having a case is phone protection and usefulness over style and this case just isn't as good as offer options for this I feel. Major dislike is the slippery feel that the hard case has on this particular style. I guess this may make it slide easier in and out of pockets and purses, but I'd be worried that it would also slip out of my hand!
title: I like the Defender series much better.

text: I ordered the imluckies Compatible with iPhone 12 Pro 6.1inch Case with 2 Pack Tempered Glass Screen Protector, PC & TPU Shockproof Protective Cover with Slide Camera Lens Cover & Rotate Kickstand, Green. It is March 3, 2023. Let's see if it passes The Final Test! NOTE) I don't use screen protectors, and therefore didn't install them. But I will consider them later on when I discuss price. 2nd NOTE) I have an iPhone 12, not 12 Pro, 12 max, or 12 mini. This fits the iPhone 12. +1) This case feels really nice to hold in your hand. I think it's the squared chamfered edges and the material they used for the screen bumper, but it's really quite nice. The Spigen case that I had been using is slipperier than a bar of soap. This case is a nice and welcome change. 2) I'm a big fan of the camera shutter. This should be especially great to all those people who have an iPhone through their work and would like that added step of privacy. I would have liked to see one for the front camera also though. -3) The big drawback of this phone case comes with the kickstand ring on the back. While it can be considered as a nice to have, it is not very sturdy and feels on the cheaper side. Couple that with the fact that this case does not support MagSafe and also cannot support wireless charging at all, it's a tough loss. $$) For between $8 and $12 you get this case and two screen protectors that are quite flexible "glass". It's an iPhone case, this price is totally subjective but I'm losing out on MagSafe so i'm unhappy. This item earned a C for Meeting Expectations.
title: Good Case, but no MagSafe/Wireless Charge

text: I loved it it was very compact and got basically what I needed it to do, I wish when I was looking I found the powercore 13000 cause it's 2 ports and slightly bigger for only a few dollars more, I sold this one to a friend a year after having it and upgraded to the powercore 26800 because it was on sale and I needed the extra ports for my switch, phone, and tablet. Both great products and would highly recommend because you get bang for your buck, don't bother going with cheaper 3rd parties, you will get a good one but it's like 1 out of 5, trust me I tried I had like 6 batteries before this and they all either got replaced or burned out after 6 months
title: Great battery

text: I've purchased a couple of these in different designs, and while I think the screw tightening employed by this particular unit provides for the most secure mounting option, there seems to have been a flaw in ours as it developed a crack over the past month that prevents this from being secured any more in the CD drive. I am not sure if this is just a flaw in this specific junit or if it is something others would see. I don't feel the unit was over tightened at any point to cause the crack but certainly once the crack started it got worse when additional attempts were made to tighten. The magnet in this is much stronger than some of the other brands I purchased, and I like the large area of the mounting surface.
title: Much to like in the design but mine developed a crack that would not allow it to tighten.

text: I am not pleased with the case. The cover is very thin. It will protect the back of the case from scratches, but I doubt that it would protect the phone from any kind of bump / fall / drop. Perhaps my case was an exception, but the case I received did not fully extend around the corners and sides of my phone (although it did stay on with some work), and the bottom of the case (near the charging port and microphone) was loose and warped, never laying flat on the phone, but protruding out in the middle. I would not recommend this case, and would not buy again.
title: Poor fit. Protects from scratches but not much more.

text: THe phone's battery is awesome. I really liked my droid turbo so I stuck with Moto. However my NEW phone is missing handy features of my OLD Droid. You can no longer mirror, except to chromecast. Even using 3rd party apps it won't recognize anything but chrome/google. The big thing is it is not hands free like my Droid. It would verbally "tell" you what a text had to say and then would ask for reply. Now you option is to press the microphone (illegal and UNSAFE) on the key board. Or as the Moto tech advised buy a newer car with android auto. Yea right$$$$$. Not sure what else is missing but the texting is a big one.
title: Good basic phone but missing past features.

text: I’ve been very happy with the product and has saved my Apple Watch Series 4 - 44mm from numerous scratches around the sides. I’ve found as shown in picture I can have some white marks show up where I hit my watch. Some gentle rubbing of the protector seems to make the white go away (I’ve wiped it down with baby wipes and other wipes) so I’m assuming it self-heals or something similar. I’ve used the protector for several months now so it’s not like your getting a first day review. I’ve not noticed any excessive build-up of grime or dust. If any dust does appear, a gentle wipe even with my shirt and the protector is nice and clean. No oily residue, doesn’t interfere with the use of the device nor does it cause problems for any monitoring. After a few days of use, you grow accustom to the extra feeling of the protector. Definitely something that I wasn’t expecting. I had a friend tell me these are a waste of money, but they’ve protected my watch without fail and it’s exactly what I wanted from it. Thank you MENEEA for making a great product. Would buy again.
title: Great watch protector - especially for the price

text: Let me highlight some negatives about this product.. honestly there is nothing i can quote as an issue with this product as such. But considering its delivery speed.. you will even forget that you ordered for this when you see it in your mail box..:) It did happen my case. I waited for almote 4 and a 1/2 weeks to get it. May be they are passing on it through some passengers from Hongkong i guess..:0.. But on a serious note this is an excellent case for S3. It fits like a tailor-made case for S3. It has 3 parts you shouldn't find it difficult to fit them appropriately. You may look for a different color(not sire if they sell one) if you are bored of the black ones. But I m lovin it :) Don't think too much about the delivery speed as you an never imagine a better case for this price.. 3.75$ seriously?? Worth it a ton times!!
title: The best case for S3... but your patience will be tested hard:)

text: I bought this screen protector because I wanted the most coverage I could get on my phone. I saw that it had stellar reviews and that is would work with my case, a teal otter box commuter series that is amazing. I followed all the instructions for insulation and after getting the bubbles out and making sure that I had completed insulation I started using my phone. Now I am leaving it one star because it fell off. During this small window where it stayed on loved how I could almost not tell that it was even there. Approximately three hours after installing the screen protector I turned my phone upside down and started walking backstage when I heard it fall off. I could not get the protector to stay on so I quickly chucked it onto the dash of my car and went back to work. I do not know if this has happened to others but it pisses me off that this happened. Maby it was a fluke. I only remembered I might be able to return it after cleaning my car. I have dropped my phone many times and do not have any big cracks in it.
title: Fell off withing 3 hours of installation.

text: Completely turned poor engineering decision into a great phone. As I've been using my S8 for a couple months now, upon initial impression, I was completely in disagreement with the fingerprint scanner placement like many others out there. Without this case I stumbled around seemingly in the dark trying to find the light switch...fingerprint scanner. With the i-Blason Halo case, the problem is solved. The pricise cut out and fit of this case to the S8 is remarkable, with near perfection fit. With the cut out window just right for this phone for the camera, fingerprint scanner and pulse reader, with my right finger, the case provides feedback for me when I slide my finger precisely to the end to unlock my phone. The fingerprint reader on the S8 is super responsive and flawless, now that it's in its 6th gen or so. The iris scanner is cool and does pretty well, but it's not as precise and responsive as the now developed fingerprint unlock technology. So, I love this i-Blason case. The clear back design allows the full unimpeded beautiful view of the S8. The antislip rubber casing turned what is otherwise quite a slippery phone into a fully confidence endorsed hand held device. This case is worth every penny, and it has been the case of choice for me since I discovered it on my S6 Edge. Since then, I've ordered it for each of my Samsung phones starting with the S6 Edge, Note 5, S7, S7 Edge, S8, and newly Note 8. All of which carry the same precision and fit. It's all that good. As Mr. Quality and Value, I approved this case and confidently, approve the other iterations I mentioned.
title: i-Blason Halo -- my best choice for Samsung phone cases - great case!

text: As much as these gadgets cost these days, you'd think they would do 'Everything' their predicessor does in addition to the newest features and upgrqdes that makes them be much better than the previoud model! Lots of Camera upgrades but you have to make choices everytime you try to take a picture on your maiden voyage of attempting to use it - Annoying, just let me take the picture. Several other choices have to be made as well, as you venture through your initial use of any new feature. No sooner than I was able to sit still long enough to go through the phone and get it set up the way (I) wanted it... There was an OS update that totally wiped out all my work and now I have to go back through it again to see what I can salvage from my initial efforts. *The biggest dissapointment for me, is both the fact that the screen won't stay on during charging, which means you can't use it as a display for your music as your playing tunes, as well it no longer displays an image of the album cover of the music being played on Pandora on the locked screen. It's the simple things that are missing here, even my way older S4 and LG V20 both do those things and I expected the same from a very much more, like 3or 4 times more, expensive phone! Over-hyped, Over-priced and missing several of the simple things that made using one of these devices for more than just a phone, worth the cost!
title: It's nice but way over-hyped!

text: Well, the description does not lie but it really is a waste of money to buy this product. I dropped my phone from my lap getting out of my car which is actually lower than 2 feet and the screen shattered but the tempered "screen protector" did not. If you are buying this to keep your screen from getting scratched then it seems that it will do that job for you. If, however, you are buying this to keep that beautiful screen from breaking, save yourself the time and don't buy it. I think the film based screen protection is the best. The major flaw with the film based protection is that it will come off in the corners and eventually you will need to replace it. The other issue is that it is not easy to install BUT I have dropped my other phone a ton of times from much higher than 3 feet and never broke a screen.
title: Not a Drop Protector; buy film based protection if you expect to drop your phone.

text: UPDATE. I have had this applied to my phone case for four months now. I applied it at the very bottom edge of the case and over the months it has worked itself up about an inch from the bottom Putting the top of the pocket starting to cover the camera now. It seems impossible with the level of tackiness to the adhesive used, that it could ever even come off but it has managed to slowly slide up the back of the case. As the pocket has slid up the back it started to cover the camera lense. The pocket is nearly impossible to remove from your case because of the adhesive that is left behind but I was able to remove it using a blow dryer. The iridescent finish is still intact and has held up well. If it wasn’t for it working itself up the back of the phone I would have kept using it. I have updated the rating from five stars to three stars. This is awesome!! I don’t carry a purse and I was always misplacing my DL and bank card by carrying them in my pocket. Not anymore! I always have them and never forget them or lose them! I’ve been using it on my phone for 2 weeks. So far it hasn’t peeled off the back of the phone or even lifted on any edges or corners. The color is still a vibrant iridescent! Love it!!!
title: LOVE IT!

text: Worked great for exactly 2 months and now doesn’t charge my iPhone X, the blue LED just flashes. I’m a big fan of Anker but this thing is junk. Update: Anker was quick to send a replacement, but the unit started working again before it arrived. My issue could be related to the output of the APC UPS USB port the Anker is plugged into. Upgraded to 3 stars for support, but be aware the power output of your USB port can cause intermittent issues. Update: Replacement unit has failed after one month. Blue LED just blinks when iPhone X is placed on top. Frustrating!
title: Worked great for exactly 2 months and now doesn’t charge my iPhone X

text: This case is built like a tank! It feels very secure and strong. It wasn't hard to put on the iPhone, but it takes a fair amount of effort to remove it. I installed it before the sim card. My mistake, but it required me to remove it in order to install the new sim. I ended up watching a YouTube video that explained how to remove it. The hardest part is getting it started, and working it around to remove it. All in all I really like this case. Fits nice and tight, though I have not been brave enough to test if it is water proof. I hope so. All in all this is a great fitting case that I am happy with. Well worth a full five stars.
title: LifeProof FRĒ SERIES Waterproof Case for iPhone 11 - Well Made - Fits Fantastic!

text: Great product over all, I bought 4 more 2 days after getting my first. Desk, bedside, etc. - all using this for several days now. Only nit - I would tweak the holder a bit so a Pixel5's fingerprint sensor was still available. (Sidenote: of you keep the phone about 1/3" from the bottom it will still close + charge, and the fingerprint sensor is available.) AND TUNE DOWN THE BLUE LIGHT - it is insanely bright in a dark room (yes, I have one in my home office and one in my bedroom). I have had to use electrical tape to kill the brightness. Also - for the intended car uses - that bright blue light is bad for several reasons, theft + battery drain come to mind.
title: Worth buying 2 or 5 of - but could use a tweak it two.

text: The Belkin formed leather case for my iPhone has been a disappointment. It fits the phone fairly well, but there are 3 significant flaws that constantly annoy me, and I am now, after 3 weeks, shopping for an alternative. The case seems to be well-constructed, durable, and attractive. But, the design flaws are: 1. the hole in the back for the camera lens does not align well with the camera. I have to take the phone out of the case to use the camers. 2. the clip on the back is difficult to clip onto things (like a belt) and also hard to pull back off. This makes me feel confident that the phone won't fall off accidentally, but it is also hard to use. 3. the select button is very, very hard to push through the case. The button is slightly recessed, and the case does not adequately allow for this, so you have to really push hard to make the button work. Since this button is the main interface with the phone, this is a real problem. All in all, this case is not worth the price.
title: Wish I'd picked a different one

text: Ive had this case and tempered glass for roughly a month now, give or take. I love the case its cute, clear to see my colored phone. However, the tempered glass cracked already. My 2 year old gets ahold of my phone when I forget to grab it when I get up from wherever I'm sitting. He's quick. Between him dropping/throwing my phone and myself dropping it, the tempered glass cracked. Its only noticeable if I angle my phone a certain way though. The tempered glass and case were easy to assemble and put on. Overall I really like this case.
title: Overall great

text: I really, really, really wanted to like this case because it is an awesome looking case. It looks like it would do a pretty good job of protecting my phone but it doesn't seem to work with a tempered glass screen protector. It ended up popping it off right away. Some of that is due to the poor design of these trendy curved glass screens and it also could have been due to a bad screen protector. The most important part of the phone is the screen and this case really had no way of protecting it unless it happens to fall exactly flat. Had to return it...
title: Really wanted to like this...

text: Pretty good case. Seems well-built. Decent fit, but easy to remove. All the cutouts are the right size. Slim, but not too slim. Easy to hold in one hand. The buttons are a little stiff with the case on, which makes double pressing the power button to turn on the camera slightly less than easy. I also noticed a small increase in phone signal when I took the case off. No way to tell for sure if the case was actually partially blocking my signal, but I suspect it was. I ended up returning it in favor of something a little lighter-weight, but it's still a good case.
title: Good case. Bit heavy for a slim case. Well-made. Buttons a little stiff and possible partial signal block

text: The phone I originally bought this case for got stolen. Of course that meant the case was stolen too. I loved that phone, so I got the same model to replace the original, and bought a second copy of the same cover as well. I'm terrible about dropping my phone, but this case has kept the phone from sustaining any damage. The second time I ordered this, the wrong color (purple) was mailed to me. As soon as I sent a message about the mistake, the correct one was mailed to me. I didn't even have to send back the purple one. What service!
title: This case has saved my phone from so many falls.

text: It works well. However, the description said it had NO stickiness on the suction cup pad, but it did, so I couldn't put it on my dashboard for fear of it staying forever. EDIT: After a year and a half, I'm lowered my rating from 4 to 1 star. The sticky layer on the suction cup melted and oozed down my windshield. Luckily, it oozed very slowly, so it didn't leak onto the dashboard....but it was gross and required quite a lot of goo gone wipes to clean up the mess. Then, I tried to complain about this poor quality to the manufacturer, and they said that they won't stand by their product because it's more than a year after purchase. I am so disappointed, both in the product, and in the poor way that the company handled my complaint. I'd avoid this product and this company!
title: It works well. However, the description said it ...

text: Pros: fits perfectly and easy to install (just have to remove one band and slide on). I also like that it protects the corners of the watch. Cons: I wash my hands pretty frequently and water gets underneath leaving smudges between the cover and the watch as seen in the photo. It can also happen on the base of the watch as well around the sensor. Unless you have a trick to keep water from coming in, I just take it off and clean it regularly to avoid it or any smelliness. Also, if not applied perfectly, air bubbles can make the touch screen difficult to use. Not an AMAZING product but good enough for now.
title: 40mm screen protector

text: Frankly I was disappointed. Its design makes using the USB ports awkward to use or worse in most cars I drive (and I rent many different models) because the charge port in most cars is usually recessed and doesn't allow access to the USB ports once this device is plugged in. And the USB ports are the whole reason for buying this since it doesn't add any charging advantages, such as adding to the number of ports, so why bother? I did not see any LED power indicators as mentioned in product description. This is especially troublesome because I had to push it in very hard in order for it to carry a charge, and I need something I can rely on during long trips. I will have to buy something else and then toss this into the glove compartment and only use it as a last-ditch backup just in case. Here's hoping that I won't need to.
title: Poor design and not reliable

text: The color is nice. Seems hard to find a mint case for some reason. Other than that I don't care for it. There is no kind of grip so your phone just slides all over the place, It adds unnecessary bulk to the phone, and doesn't seem to provide any kind of cushioning for drops. My biggest issue with this case is that the buttons are constantly being pressed accidentally. In your bag, in your pocket, in your hand, wherever. Many times my phone has turned off while in my bag from the power button being held down or the volume of my music will turn all the way down.
title: Nice color, buttons mistakenly pressed all the time

text: First off I'm glad to have something to cover my screen with but I won't buy this screen protector again. The installation video got a little confusing and I wasted one screen protector because it got messed up while installing. Once I used the second screen protector I got it on fine though this would not work nicely with the s pen, as the pen and my nail leaves dents in the screen. I guess this is good if you're on a budget and need to protect your screen asap. Next time I'll just pay a little more for tempered glass, I've learned my lesson now lol
title: Wouldn't buy again

text: I got this case to fit my iPhone 12. I typically like slim cases to just protect against scratching and small drops. So far, knock on wood, i haven’t broke a screen or phone yet. However, for the 12, the cameras do stick out quite a bit from the body so wanted a slightly thicker case to protect the lenses when I put the phone down on its back. This case was thick enough without adding too much bulk to protect the camera lenses and also wrapped up over the screen to offer more protection. Makes me feel more at ease. I haven’t dropped it so can’t tell how well it will do, but hey, it’s better than a slim case and it has Stitch! The graphic design is attractive without being overdone. I even got questions while at WDW on where in the park I bought it. Anyays, I recommend the case. I would buy it again.
title: Good Case and it has Stitch!

text: Easy and cheap. I bought this in September (5mos ago), and at the same time I bought tempered glass. I was satisfied until now. I'm not rough with my phone. But, today when I opened it up to remove my microSD card, and the entire back of my phone is cracked. the front tempered glass was also correct. But luckily the front of the phone was unaffected behind the glass. Who knew that the back of the phone was made of glass? But... Isn't that why we have cases? Granted I only have myself to blame for purchasing and $8 case. Buying an OtterBox today. And it'll cost me $100 to replace the back. although no one will see the back, I'd rather it not become a greater problem in the future if I don't get it fixed.
title: Not durable. Within five months, the back of this phone is cracked.

text: Decent stylus with a few issues. I have never used a stylus with my iPad before but bought one when I decided to use Procreate. The pressure sensitivity is not consistent but tilt is. I tried multiple different ways but I can’t get the pressure sensitivity to work correctly. The charge port cover is a tiny little silicon piece which does not have a tab connecting it to the stylus. Unfortunately it has popped off while I’m using the stylus because I fidget. I see myself losing this at some point. I haven’t been able to figure out how long the battery actually lasts because it keeps turning off on its own at random. I’ve fully charged it and it still keeps happening. I even made sure to check that I am not accidentally turning it off while fidgeting. Overall this is a decent option if you don’t want to shell out the extra $$ for an Apple one and only plan on using it occasionally.
title: Ok for occasional use

text: Eventually after at least a week the bubbles finally disappeared and the damage from the squeegee seemed to heal. The protector is easy to mark up but it seems to heal eventually after a long wait. With both attempts I wasn't able to get the protector on without the case pulling up a corner. I've been playing this screen protector game for a while now and here's what I've learned..... Only read reviews for verified purchases (there are a lot of fakes) and you will see that there are no perfect cases out there, there are pretty much all the same. The curved glass of the s8 makes it nearly impossible to get a perfect fit with what they have on the market for this. The glass ones will almost always leave a gap that causes bad touch response or clicking or a rainbow effect and the adhesives on them are very poor. The plastic ones like this one give you a better chance at the effect that you have no screen protector on there, but they are extremely difficult to get on without issues of bubbles and case interference. Going to try the Spigen one next with my Spigen case, they require you to have your case on when installing.
title: Good luck and what I've learned so far about screen protectors

text: On Android it required me to sideload the updated app from DJI's website to get it to work. The app that was current in the app store could not connect to it. My first time out with it I went rollerblading around the block with my two little girls and tried to record video. I was really disappointed that most of the video I thought I was recording never recorded. This was due to the bluetooth becoming disconnected from my Google Pixel 3xl soon after we started. There was no big warning or anything and I was skating so I wasn't staring at the screen looking for little things to let me know it wasn't linked anymore. When the moment was right I'd press record and then press it again to stop. Got home, looked for the videos, and only found the first test one I shot while I was in the driveway before we left. The phone never left the mount the entire time but disconnected and stayed disconnected right away. I do not have any other bluetooth issues when using other devices. I don't think it has enough range of movement. You end up having to pull out the extension a little bit almost every time I use it and manually tilt it to find the right angle for the stabilizer to work well. Not at all a turn on and go for most situations. Has a ton of great features and I look forward to taking advantage of them more.
title: Not sure yet. Has had some issues.

text: Yoga Teacher Wife here, .....I decided to upgrade from my foam blocks when I started teaching yoga at a local fitness center. These blocks are just what I wanted. They are wide enough to get a good hand/palm positions and heavy enough to provide good support without worrying about the block tipping over. The rounded edges make then suitable for propping under your back. They arrived in great condition with no "smell". Getting 2 blocks for around $24 bucks was a bargain ! The only downside if you take your blocks to and from the studio is that they are heavy. Small price to pay for good stability in asanas.
title: Stable Support

text: The case itself is great. It's durable as I've dropped it a couple times with no issues and the buttons work great with it. There are 2 problems I've ran into in the 4 months I've had it. One: Even though I take care to put it in my purse in a section by itself, the screen still scratched easy. Two: it's hard to pull down the notifications slide down feature. Other than that it's great if you don't mind having the screen scratched up which drives me crazy. It's too late to return so I'm putting it away and getting out my old wallet style one as it's the only one I have to help keep the screen protected.
title: The case itself is great. It's durable as I've dropped it a couple ...

text: Hard to put the frame on and even harder to take it off. Follow the instructions in the package!!!. There are protective films both inside and outside the case which need to be peeled off and a pain to peel off. The cutouts at the bottom of the frame have sharp edges and if you hold the phone with your pinky finger at the bottom,you can feel the sharp edges digging into your finger. The case does add a little more bulk to the phone than i expected. The buttons work really well and the cutouts for headphone jack and charger are big enough. The looks of the case are neither cheap nor premium , i would say they are decent.
title: A pain to put on and take off

text: The case is very sturdily built and the install is easy. For phone protection, its a win, but the fingerprint reader, is a total no-go. The Touch Sensitivity is turned on in the Display Settings. The advertised feature of working with the finger print reader was a key factor in selecting this case. Also, I have wireless chargers at work, home and in the cars. With this case the phone would only charge on about half of these. I suspect the gap between the rear of the case and the phone may be the issue as all of the chargers work without the case.
title: Fingerprint Reader Won't Work, Some Wireless Chargers Won't Work

text: I picked this up and sized it up on my phone before returning it. It looks like it might be ok, but it's just a tiny bit too small. It does cover more of the screen than many other screen protectors that have come out so far for the Pixel 2, but there's still enough space around the edges to make me wary. If it was a fully clear screen this wouldn't be that bad but with the black borders it's annoying. If you're going to use the borders you should really have 100% coverage of the screen. It also looked like it would dull the image quality noticeably. I'm sticking with the also somewhat mediocre one I have now until a better one comes out.
title: It looks like it might be ok

text: This review is not based on how it looks; it’s cute and sporty for a baseball fan. I purchased 2 of these one for myself and one for my husband. Both of them were difficult to put onto our watches. My husband’s band which is the 45 mm, the silver pieces where you slide into the watch were sticking up to where they were difficult to put on. After much work it was on; then came time to take off the band. The band tore away from the section in the watch and we had to use a pair of tweezers to slowly work out the silver parts stuck in the watch. So the band is now tore and worthless. Wouldn’t recommend unless you’re prepared to dig watch band pieces out of your Apple Watch.
title: Poor quality design

text: After my husband lost his actual Apple Pencil 2 I went looking for a cheaper but similar quality alternative, and finally I’ve found one. This pencil uses wireless charging just like the original and pairs by Bluetooth with the iPad Pro 11” 3rd generation. It feels slightly more lightweight than a normal Apple Pencil, but it’s almost nicer to hold than the original. I also like the fact that this way the pencil can match the iPad in the black color we ordered. The sensitivity is all there, and works just as flawlessly as the original. I couldn’t be more impressed for the price especially since two extra nibs were included as well.
title: Feels Nice in the Hand

text: Fits really well, the kickstand is very well designed, and the whole case hugs the phone. I have two comments on the product, the first is that I wouldn't advise getting into a car with the belt clip on, at least for myself the case tends to catch on things. The second is that the case is just barely visible when using the wide angle lens, in the tiniest section of the corner at the top, but once I readjusted the phone, it wasn't visible anymore. I had the belt clip crack off on the first day, but upon informing Zizo, they expressed me a replacement hip holder, which has continued to serve me well. Overall I love this case, and would buy again.
title: Great Customer Service, Even Better Case!

text: This thing is great. Got the neon color so it could stand out while running. Real easy to slip my phone in and out and can work with or without corded headphones. I would just actually recommend measuring your arm to pick the size, mine was a little tight (cus I juat guessed) so I might get 1 size up but it's still not too tight cus its very stretchy. I can also just soak it in some soap and hot water every once in the while in the sink if it starts to stink but it dries very fast. You also never have to worry about the velcro getting old and ripping or not working...cus there is none. Would recommend.
title: Would recommend

text: Worked good for a few months then it started getting flaky. Did some investigating and found out that the copper leads on plug were starting to wear off from unplugging them to sync the phone. Now I usually only unplugged it maybe once a week to sync/backup to my computer so it wasn't like I was sitting there all day unplugging it. I contacted Spigen about the issue and they sent me a replacement case no questions asked. Well I had the new case for a few months and the same thing started happening! So I contacted support again, this time they started getting rude with me and telling me that I must be abusing the case. I informed them that I was an Apple Certified Technician and that I worked for a very large school district and I knew how to properly care for and handle my electronics and told them if they weren't going to replace it that I would make sure everyone knew of the bad experience I had, including my boss (who makes decisions on which cases to purchase for thousands of iPads). They backpedaled a little and sent me another replacement but told me if it happened again that I was basically SOL. The final replacement I got kept working and is still working, I have since purchased an iPhone 7 so I can no longer use the case.
title: Worked good for a few months then it started getting flaky

text: A good quality product. Within the first few uses, I saw some wear on the tan portion of the tab used to close the case. However, I haven't seen any more wear over the past two weeks. It is a functional case -- I have put three cards in the spaces provided and had no trouble keeping it closed. In fact, I sometimes keep the case open for quick access to the phone. However, when I need the phone to be tucked away and protected, the case does just that. The phone and case also fits into the interior pocket of my handbags. I'm referring to the twin pockets on the inside that are usually perfect for holding the phone or ipod. One thing: you might want to add screen protectors to your purchase. Since most screen protectors do leave a 1-2 mm allowance at the edges, you will be able to use one with this case, as I do.
title: Very Handy

text: This is a very nice, quality, stylish watch band. The fitting of the links is fairly challenging even with the very nice tool provided. When I did get it to the size I liked, I couldn't get my hand through the opening in the unlatched position. I had to add one more link to a slightly looser fit, to get my hand through. The other magnetic mesh band is quite nice also. The magnet worked quite well. Only on a few aggressive arm actions did it slide a little to a loose position. I switched bands because it was a bit challenging to get the magnetic tab on the one end into the very thin opening on the other half of the band. Both bands use an original Samsung type adapter that clips on smoothly to the S2 watch, but then uses a traditional pin to attach the band to the adapter, not as nice looking as one would hope, but still an acceptable replacement band.
title: Great Bands But!

text: New updated review June 6, 2022: I purchased this on Sep 22, 2020. I don't use this controller much, just once a week for less than 2 hours to have XBOX game time with my son. In fact, weeks went by when I didn't use the controller at all. A few weeks ago, the left side of the controller only lets me go in the 2 o'clock direction, none of the buttons work, and now it's just junk. Just a $100 piece of trash. That's been my experience with this controller. Old review: I don't like it. I love it! Though, no fault of the manufacturer or the controller, this controller made me wish I bought a Samsung S9+ instead of the 9 because of the larger screen the S9+ has! Pro's: It feels comfortable in my hands. The face buttons and analog sticks feel like good quality. It worked right out of the box--i didn't need to install any apps to make it work. Con's: It's only Type C, so check what type of plug you got. I have to remove my phone case each time I want to put it into this controller. The left/right trigger buttons squeak when I press them down, they don't feel as solid as an Xbox trigger. Nonetheless, I think it's a good buy!
title: Broken Controller Update

text: This is one of those items that you contemplate buying, not sure if it's necessary or useful. Well, contemplate no more. I love everything about this product. Let me start with my first hesitation, which was sticking a magnet to my phone. Until I was told that I could slide the magnet between my phone and my case without applying the sticker side. Great, let's set this thing up. I did have to stick the main piece to my car but that didn't really bother me, personally. I think that's common amongst this type of product. So, I'm all set ready for my two hour drive and in heaven. I didn't have to glance down or fumble around for my phone. My GPS was set, my phone was connected to the magnet, connected to my car charger and my auxiliary. The placement that I chose was perfect. I never would have expected to become dependent on this product but I am. I think everyone should have one because it makes driving and navigating a safer and easier process. I received this product at a discounted rate in exchange for mt honest and unbiased opinion.
title: Simplicity at its finest!

text: I don't see a way to contact the seller after purchase, but the case came with nick in the corner of the case. I'd have given it 4 if it hadn't come with that defect. It looks like it was cut with a blade. I like the case overall, but I think something about it feels a little off or cheap. I'm not sure exactly why. I think it may be the plastic is a little dull or the seam joints in the plastic are a little sharp or rough. Maybe if they were a little smoother. I don't know. I will say it did marry very well with the Daswise tempered glass kit I also purchased. I didn't use the one that came with it.
title: Good, not excellent

text: Everything perfect except the fact that the black borders are certainly somewhat large, obstructing some tiny bit of text and screen real-estate ( quite noticeable in games even though it is seemingly minor)- it is a shame because besides that it does appear to be quite a quality screen protector, but this issue is really annoying and should be fixed as soon as possible by the company, there is no reason why a nearly perfect product like this should suffer from this! Installation was easy, reapplied it in the initial laying on the displaying to limit the amount of visible air bubbles ( there was 4 on each corner) but within a few hours or maybe an hour they were all gone! As someone mentioned- initially the screen protector attracted some lint but this stopped very quickly for me. Has performed really well since this. Again this does appear to be a nearly perfect product that holds true to how it's advertised, just a bummed about the slightly large black borders, would recommend it in a heart beat other wise if that wasn't the scenario/ would blow every other protector i used out of the water.
title: NEARLY perfect with one flaw

text: I've had my Droid X for about a year. After updating the OS to 2.3.3 the camera basically stopped working. It either deletes the photo I've just taken or saves corrupted photos 90% of the time and the pictures are grainy and of poor quality. Sometimes it saves over other photos in my gallery! Total FAIL. This also is the second Droid X I've had, the first one stopped working so I got a warranty replacement (The first one had the same problem with the images too). OS. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT buy any Motorola phone. Motorola phones are of poor quality. They make them look flashy to sell but they put little thought into how reliable the actual components are.
title: Do not buy this phone. Camera is UNUSABLE

text: This does hold the phone pretty well and is adjustable for all phone size devices. It is not big enough for tablets. It is too short to put it under the mattress unless you like to lay very close to the edge of your bed. I put it under my hip when I'm laying down, but that makes the arm quite long so I have to bend it over quite a bit. The other problem is the flat stabilizing plastic at the bottom is not wide enough, it tilts and makes the thing difficult to adjust since it moves all the time. Also, I got into a weird position the other day and happened to roll over on it and the plastic base broke off from the arm. So now i'm trying to figure out how to fix it without buying another one. This product is good in concept and the part that grabs your phone works pretty well - just make sure you clamp it tight or it will drop your phone. However there are some issues and you do have to be careful with it.
title: It may work for you

text: WARNING, reviews are likely fake. There are several 5 star reviews by the same person. This protector does NOT work. I installed it on a brand new phone, i literally peeled off the film that came with the phone just before following all the instructions to install this protector. I installed it under an oven dust hood so there was no dust. The install could not have been any more clean and perfect. Touch sensitivity deteriorated every day until it was borderline unusable. A week later the protector just fell off. The package comes with 2, so i tried the second one. It fell off in less than a day. My recommendation is to switch to a flexible film protector that you install with water. the curved edges of the screen means a semi-rigid glass protector would have to be absolutely perfect in shape or it will raise off the screen and eventually detach. A film protector should form to the shape of the phone nicely.
title: Reviews are FAKE, this DOES NOT work

text: First off, if you’re looking for a case for protection, I wouldn’t recommend this one. BUT if you’re looking for a cute summer bright colored case, this is the one !! Matches well with the PopSockets neon yellow collection ! Extra plus that I didn’t know about, a little trinket hole to hang off little keychains! Brings me back to the early 2000s when phones were made with those trinket holes. I also love that this case makes my phone into a square rectangular cornered shape. Makes me feel better about not upgrading to the iPhone 12 Pro Max lol
title: Neon fluorescent yellow/green!! Obsessed!!

text: The screen is not bad. I am using mine for over a month already. It has very glassy look, which is great. It also helps to get rid of bubbles. I wouldn't call it anti-scratch just because I have couple of them already and I wouldn't say that I am using the phone under extreme conditions. I almost never hold it in my pocket, mostly in the special compartment of my bag. The most unpleasant thing about it is that it doesn't cover the whole screen of my phone. In fact, it's about 3 mm from each side, which looks odd and besides doesn't provide enough protection. It was also extremely hard to install. Because this screen protector has the protective field on the one side only it makes it flimsy to quickly align it with the phone's screen. Overall, the quality of the plastic is very good. But the execution fitting and cut are not.
title: Good, but doesn't cover the whole screen

text: I was confused when i first recieved this product because their were so many pieces. And i did not want to stick the adhesive to the back of my phone, to prevent residue. So I placed it on a case that I had for my phone. I placed it on my dashboard with my phone, just to test it out. I wanted to see how sturdy it was and if my phone was secure. The magnet aspect of it kinda scared, in case i was to stop short or hit a bumpy road. I took it on a 15minute drive to the mall and I had no problems. But that was on smooth roads. I do not know how it would hold up on a bumpier ride. I recieved this product at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review.
title: Good So Far

text: This is my first foray into wireless charging, so I was a little apprehensive. After using these chargers for a few weeks, color me impressed! They're highly convenient and perform just as advertised. I wouldn't really recommend them for car use (unless you get some kind of adhesive) as they don't have a good grip on the dashboard, but really, there are dedicated car chargers that you could easily acquire (and I plan to). I get immediate fast charging, even through my case. My wife, though, has a pop socket, so she has to remover her case to charge, but I haven't heard any complaints, and that's a limitation of the technology itself, not the charger. This was definitely a good purchase, and I plan to get another set to expand where I can charge our phones (rather than unplugging and moving it to another location). Highly recommend!
title: Immediate fast charging

text: Great kid's phone. I was pretty impressed with this phone, especially for the price. It works on the tmobile network, and will work on any gsm network. It connected to wifi easily, and my ten year old son has downloaded a ton of apps and the memory is still fine. It came with a set of headphones, and although the sound quality isn't perfect, it's still nice that they included them. The only problem we had was with the 4g being very weak when everyone else's was fine. Not sure if that's an internal issue with the phone or what, but it has seemed very slow when not on wifi. It does have decent sound, And gets pretty loud. Altogether a great starter phone, or one to replace an expensive one until you can get a replacement.
title: Great starter phone for kids

text: Very sturdy and it works great only when you use it on a smooth non textured surface like window or maybe even a smoother dashboard area. Now in my 2013 f150 I put it on the dash board and on the lower driver windshield side. It worked for like 3 days on the textured dashboard, but as soon as it got hot outside the suction cup let go. Yes I cleaned it but that didn’t help. So I moved to the windshield on the driver side and it works good there. I did notice that when it’s hot outside it will eventually let go after a week of hanging around. So I just make it a point once a week to reset it so it stays. Once it’s on it’s pretty sturdy and it’s pretty easy to adjust it how you want it. The only thing I would change about it would be the neck to be longer because most newer cars dashboards are deep. Also you should include a small sticky pad like the ones that come with similar holders or gps setups. One that can stick to textured dashboards.
title: Pretty good on the window but

text: If you're looking to add a premium touch to your OnePlus One, this is your item. I took extra care and cautuon while imstalling this glass protector, and although you've got to exercise caution while installing and it takes about 10/15 to prep your phone & install, it's totally doable and well worth the effort. The glass is SO smooth and really gives your device that extra premium feel. The touch responsiveness is excellent, the fit is flawless, and it really gives you peace-of-mind that your device is more protected. I recommend something like this to all of my friends, for sure. I was never much for screen protectors, but the appeal of glass reeled me in, and at this price, you're definitely getting a quality product in great packaging. If you're considering this for the OnePlus One, I say go for it; just be thorough & careful while imstalling & you'll have a flawlessly covered, smooth, responsive, and protected screen in no time! :)
title: Premium Addition to OPO!

text: First off, the ringlight works. It has 10-11 levels of brightness and a "warm/neutral/cool" setting. Having said that, there are several things that keep the rating for being higher. First off is the build quality. Everything about it feels like it's made of flimsy, low quality materials. Secondly, it is USB powered, but a wall adapter is not included. Finally, it was a bit smaller than I expected. Fully extended it is 47.5 inches tall which is adequate for someone seated but probably not for a standing person. It was one of the less expensive ringlights available and the quality shows it. I would hesitantly recommend it because it does what it is advertised to do, but I'm not sure how long it will last.
title: Not a bad ringlight for the price

text: Great phone case! Rubbery material like I wanted, very easy to put on & stays on well. Nice slick, smooth surface yet not slippery. Does not interfere with phone's buttons or screen protector & the color is beautiful (I got purple). I prefer soft rubbery cases to the hard ones & this case was better than my last one which I purchased from my phone's carrier. My ONLY complaint (& the reason for 4 stars instead of 5 on sturdiness & durability) is that the edges of the case are barely raised up above the screen, so I worry that with my tendency of having the dropsies, my phone won't be quite as protected. However, my last case was only a tiny bit more raised on the edges & it protected my phone after many drops. So there's that. My prior case purchased from my carrier was just enough bigger that my phone didn't fit well in my car's key/phone compartment nor was it easy to put my phone in my back pocket. By contrast, THIS phone case fits in my car's phone/key compartment nicely & my phone now easily slides into my back pocket. Overall, this is a great phone case for the money & I would most definitely buy from this seller again. Shipped 5 days after order date, however once shipped, arrived that same day. No complaints! Very pleased.
title: Great phone case for the money

text: This case is awesome looking and the side bumps help you grip the phone more securely than the regular phone body. The real carbon fiber back looks wonderful with no bubbles, smooth surface and a great visual texture. The bad thing is that the case reduces the Verizon's LTE signal enough that my phone won't switch back to LTE from 3G unless I am right next to a tower. It drops the LTE signal from -94dBm to -103dBm. It's tolerable where there is excellent covereage, but unaccaptable anywhere else. I like this case so much that instead of returning it for a refund, I'm going to try modifying it to allow more signal. I will post pictures when complete.
title: Looks amazing and is well-built, but blocks signal, especially Verizon's 700MHz LTE

text: This item was delivered very quickly and so far I'm very happy with this purchase. The kit is very easy to put together and I really like the way that it folds back up and fits right into the cardboard sleeve. Keeps everything neat and compact. I got this product to check out what Google Cardboard and VR was all about. This VR kit works out really good and are perfect 'starter' VR glasses. I didn't realize there is so much VR content already and having these glasses gives me a quick & handy way to view them. If/when I start viewing VR content for longer periods of time, I guess I'll upgrade to a pair of glasses that will be comfortable but for now, these are perfect. The price point is spot on too.
title: Perfect Starter VR Glasses

text: The application screen guide helper was very useful in placing the screen right in the center and it works well with my leather case from Samsung. For the fingerprint sensor I simply added an extra fingerprint with the protector on and it works much better, it did work before but this was simply to increase the accuracy. There is a very tiny noticeable difference when having the 9H screen protector but it works well. I used both the camera and screen protector which is compatible with my case. The only con is that there is a very small halo reflection on the loop where screen protector precisely cut for the camera.
title: So far it's pretty good!

text: Love this case. Wears better than the other one I had. My phone has been dropped several times while in this case and had no damage to the case or phone. It stretches just slightly after you use it and therefore holds multiple cards in each slot if you desire but I can shake the case without credit cards falling out. It does NOT tend to start apps or calls accidentally if you have cards in the wallet which has happened with my other wallet case. I ordered it in red and the color is true to what shows on my computer monitor. Love the look and texture of the leather. The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is because of the slight the s pen issue with the magnet if you fold the magnet all the way back. It recovers back to normal in a minute. The window over the ID slot is frosted instead of clear so you may have to remove Id more often.
title: Love this case

text: I made the ridiculous mistake of buying this twice -- once to replace the old screen protector that had become cracked and beaten up after years of service, and again a day later after, well... So this comes in a pack of 2. Item 1 -- horribly cracked for some reason. Okay. Probably my fault, as most things in life are. Item 2 -- Worked just fine until I accidentally fell asleep with the phone in my hand. Later that day. The screen protector just completely popped off, and when I found it, it wasn't broken but it lost all its stickiness and couldn't go back into place. So I sent away for a replacement. Item 3 -- I was extra careful to follow the instructions, clean the old screen really thoroughly, peel the sticky bit at the last possible second, and push down to make the screen protector go in place really well. It fell off after a few hours anyway. There's another one in the pouch, but I'm researching other brands before even trying to install it. Maybe I'll try to put it on after I've gotten ready to run some errands tomorrow, and I can see if it lasts the whole trip. (I doubt it.) I would assume these things were made to be naturally adhesive and could survive being in a pocket, but ... go off, I guess (is what the manufacturer probably said to the screen protectors.)
title: Wow, This Is Worthless!

text: I tried multiple times to install this on a brand new out of the box iPhone 11. Despite two unsuccessful attempts I could not keep it from causing large air bubbles which were impossible to push out. The third attempt was a little bit more successful but there was still an air bubble, the sides of the screen are not lying down (air bubble on the side too!) and have not adhered properly causing a rainbow like distortion on the edge of the screen saver itself. text: In evaluating a screen cover, I imagine there are 3 metrics which are most important; ease of application, clarity/protection, and value. The instructional video method of using stickers to lift and applying all at once is not intuitive and fundamentally flawed in applying evenly without bubbles. I have had a MUCH easier time using other protective covers that apply diagonally and the back removes as it seals to the glass 2) Value - yes, you get three in a pack. But unless you're doing this for all your friends, that's meaningless. Additionally, due to challenges applying the cover, you may use all of them to get one good seal. I would like to update my review on the clarity and protection afforded: 3) Clarity/protection - There is actually a 2nd backing which is on the screen after application. I initially thought this was the screen cover because it came off when I slid my phone into my jeans pocket. Upon closer inspection, I saw that there was a very thin protective cover that was in place; it's just extremely thin. I've seen enough comments online with similar issues to believe this may not be an uncommon issue. Other than the battery the phone is as good as you can expect for the price. At times the performance will feel a little rougher than higher end phones, as expected, but I would have been more than happy to continue using this phone for 2-3 years if the battery had held out. Prior to this phone I had used a moto g5 plus. I saw little to no difference between the g6 and the g5 plus. It blends in since I have the gold iPhone but when you remove the case you can see the yellowing around the edges versus day 1 crystal clear. I’ll still use it since the stand is very useful and it functions 100% but be wary that it will eventually yellow. I have had this case on my iPhone 14 Pro since it came out. So around the longest period a person could have it for.
title: Started to yellow after 4-5 months

text: As a charger, it's excellent! Mine is attached to the frame of my dorm bed using velcro Command strips. My only complaint is that it REALLY grips the USB plugs, to the extent that I can only unplug my iPhone cord if I pull on the wire; I can't get enough grip on the plug part to pull it out! Pulling from the wire regularly will drastically reduce the life of your cables, so this is enough reason to reduce my rating by a star. Anker in general produces very high-quality chargers, and again, the grip thing is my only complaint. Otherwise, it's great: unlike some chargers, it doesn't heat up at all, and it makes no noise at all (many make a quiet buzz or whine, which makes them unsuitable for bedside use if you have good hearing). Very well made.
title: Great, but its handshake is too firm!

text: It's a good speaker , it charges well and will last a good amount of time , I use it in my car because my whole sound system went bonkers so it serves as agood substitute. I left it in my car one time on a mild day (not too hot) & it had trouble starting up (connection would glitch) for a couple mins . I turned it off and put the AC on blast and turned it back on and it worked fine , now I don't leave it in my car ever unless it's a rainy day where I know it won't warm up at all . Worth it for the price it is :) *im a poor college student haha*
title: Works for me

text: This case is all the hype even tho the price was pretty steep but you get what you paid for. Like for example I must have left the case open one day while in the water I was like omg my phone is a goner but no even with the case cracked open it sealed so grate no water got in. title: i just love it

text: THE PERKS: This is a beautiful case. I also loved the fact that you can store cards/cash in the cover. I would be able to just bring my phone somewhere instead of a purse, which was great because I don't like carrying a bunch of extra stuff. It also seems to be made well and will last a long time. THE PROBLEM: When you drop your phone, it WILL land cover open, screen down. I have a completely smashed screen now because I accidentally dropped it. (This was with one card in the cover, about 5 months after purchasing the case) We tested it a few times after (over a soft landing) and even when we held the phone cover closed, screen up, and dropped it straight down, it flipped itself over and landed screen down. And it doesn't protect the front of the phone at all when the cover is open. Bottom line: If you want a nice case to carry your phone around in, get this one. If you want one to protect your phone in case you drop it, do not.
title: Pretty, yes. Protective, no.

text: I got this phone because I work on a farm and wanted something rugged. This phone is definitely rugged. I liked that it was waterproof too. However it is NOT as waterproof as they claim. I had it in the hot tub, took an underwater picture with it since it has an underwater camera. Then i kept it outside of the hot tub to play some music. Well, the steam must have got into the speaker because it stopped working. 3 weeks later the speaker randomly started working again, but I could never get reception around the house. I thought maybe it was because I lived in a rural area, but recently I tried my 7 year old Galaxy 5 and that gets perfect reception everywhere. I loved the phone, but had to return it because it just wasn't reliable.
title: Sturdy but not reliable

text: When it was time to put the thermo plate onto the new display screen, it wouldn't fit properly which caused me to have to bend the metal pieces on the sides of the display to open them up wider so that the thermo plate would fall into place. This was definitely the fault of the company and not something I had done wrong. I watched the tutorial video on youtube (his slid in with no problem) and read the entire instruction manual while I went through the process. I followed every single step correctly. At the end when I was all done and ready to snap the new display screen into place, it wasn't fitting properly. I did exactly what the video said to do which was start from the top at a 20 degree angle and make sure it fits in before snapping the bottom in and then the sides. Now I have a new display screen that is popping out of the frame especially on the left side, and I cannot get it to snap in (and yes, I did the test with a note card to make sure it didn't slide under my phone while I was laying it flat before I started.) I truly believe that this is the company's error in not making the sizes correct to fit the iPhone 5 because I am 100% confident that I followed every single instruction correctly. I had no other problems besides the parts they sent me not fitting. Maybe they are just inconsistent with the product they make and send out some that aren't sized correctly. All I know is, I would really love a refund because I now have to take it to a repair shop to have someone fix this problem.
title: Did not fit my phone properly

text: First things first - filter your reviews by verified purchases only!!! Take this from a new Galaxy S8 owner who has wasted money on 3 different screen protectors. Reading up on tech forums, it seems the best approach for the S8 is to get a film protector + strong case. Most of the glass ones are defective like these. Ok. So the screen protector is terrible for a number of reason. First, the adhesive is terribly weak. It's slides with just a little bit of force immediately after application. After spending half a work day in and out of my pocket, the adhesive is gone, and the protector no longer stays on the phone. Second, the "glass" is a stain magnet. Your fingerprints will show up all over the glass, which to be fair, is expected. But, this one is particularly bad since the oils on your finger will cause screen glares that makes it hard to even see your phone. Third, the edges of the protector is exposed. Picked up tons of dust within my first day of use. Makes it looks like you had not cleaned your phone in months.
title: Filter your reviews by verified purchases only! Adhesive wears off after 1 day of use + many other defects.

text: Got this case for my iPhone because it has a nice grippy border. Feels good, back shell is not hard but protective enough to prevent scratches and dings. Corners of the case are reinforced pretty well. But going to return it because I feel the lip on the front that keeps the screen from touching the surface is just not high enough. If you have a screen protector then you are probably OK, but then again a thick protector may be thicker than the lip height.
